scope: Offline deterministic seed-zero full-workload calibration; the overtime current-screen duel policy is a changed workload policy, not prior GH/browser equivalence.

policy.baseline: frozen GH planner at each 300-tick decision boundary
policy.emergency: only in overtime with one south lane tower remaining; inspect each currently tower-targeting north unit in current distance-to-lane order; consider affordable singleton counters at the nearest legal own-side point; require the actual spawned body to acquire that current screen, be within the screen’s current attack range, and survive its projected attack cadence until the estimated counter kill; replace a coincident baseline command with the selected screen duel
policy.placement: nearest legal own-side point to the selected current attacker position, using the existing deployment evaluator
stateAdaptiveInputs: number and HP of surviving south lane towers
observed active-cycle remaining ticks or projected deploy/approach/first-hit schedule
public target-acquisition result for every spawned counter member
estimateLimits: future target schedules assume current tower target and attack cadence persist
projected movement and projectile travel use roster speed and estimated tower footprint
counter ETA assumes eligible members retain the observed acquisition and omits future retargeting/projectile travel
body radii use unverified runtime questions
